newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila reschedules Q1 GNP announcement.
newsitem.headline: Manila reschedules Q1 GNP announcement.

text.p: The Philippines' National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) said it had rescheduled the announcement of the first quarter gross national product (GNP) to 1:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) from 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Thursday.
NEDA secretary-general Cielito Habito earlier said the GNP "will be around the same vicinity" as the 6.6 percent level registered in the same period last year.
A recent Reuter poll of seven brokerage houses showed that they were expecting the GNP to ease to an average of 6.34 percent for the first three months of the year.
